COMPARISON: None available.

FINDINGS:

EXAM: CT ANGIOGRAPHY NECK

COMPARISON: None available.

FINDINGS:

IMPRESSION:

1. Incidental right thyroid nodule with suspicious right level IV lymph node.
2. No hemodynamically significant carotid stenosis.

IMPRESSION:
